abstract: For study of the correlation between differentiation and organ colonization properties of tumor cells, F9 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells were treated with retinoic acid, an inducer of differentiation; and their organ colonization pattern was assessed by the experimental metastasis assay. Untreated cells were found to colonize the liver, whereas treated cells colonized the lungs. This pattern held true when metastases were scored after spontaneous death or after a careful microscopic search for micrometastases. Histologic examination revealed that both the tumor nodules produced by the untreated and the treated cells had the characteristics of EC devoid of any evidence of differentiation. The immunohistochemical study of the expression of markers typical of embryonal carcinoma cells or of the extracellular matrix components laminin and collagen type IV, typical of differentiated cells, confirmed these results. However, the lack of expression of stage-specific embryonal antigen 1 (SSEA-1), a marker generally associated with the undifferentiated state, observed only in the tumors obtained after injection of treated cells, indicates that the lung nodules probably derive from cells that have responded to the induction in vitro but have dedifferentiated in vivo.
abstract_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸で処理して分化を誘導し、実験的転移アッセイにより臓器への定着パターンを評価した。未処理細胞は肝臓に、処理細胞は肺に定着した。このパターンは、自然死後に転移を評価した場合でも、微小転移を注意深く顕微鏡で探索した場合でも同様であった。組織学的検討では、未処理・処理のいずれの細胞による腫瘍結節も、分化の所見を欠く胎児性癌の特徴を示した。胎児性癌マーカーおよび分化細胞に特徴的な細胞外基質成分であるラミニンとIV型コラーゲンの免疫組織化学的検討も、これらの結果を裏付けた。しかし、未分化状態と関連するマーカーであるSSEA-1の発現欠如は、処理細胞を注射して得られた腫瘍でのみ観察され、肺結節はin vitroで誘導に反応したがin vivoで脱分化した細胞に由来すると考えられる。
